snippet.title: Glaciered - The Sea of Tranquillity Trailer
snippet.description:
Soar the seas at the end of time. 65 million years in the future, the world has frozen over, and the oceans have been sealed under a thick layer of ice. Become a Tuai—a species that evolved from birds—and protect the Everwinter in this futuristic underwater action game.
■Steam Page:https://store.steampowered.com/app/2052300

Glaciered is currently under development. Please add the game to your Steam wishlist and look forward to more updates!
